text: Four researchers published a study of that night. They put the average density during the crush at seven point five seven people per square metre.
provenance: In 2024 four researchers published a study of that night in PLOS One, reconstructing the crowd from the record.

text: The alley was full in both directions: people coming up from the bottom, and people coming down from the top.
provenance: By the middle of the evening the alley was full, and it was full in both directions: people coming up from the station at the bottom, and people coming down from the streets at the top, in a passage that narrows as it descends.

text: A crowd on flat ground has one thing going for it: the pressure has somewhere to go, in every direction at once. A crowd being fed into a passage from both ends has none.
provenance: A crowd on flat ground that becomes too dense has one thing going for it: the pressure has somewhere to go, in every direction at once.
A crowd being fed into that passage from both ends has none.

text: At the density those researchers measured, a person cannot lift their arms. The direction they travel is decided by the people behind them.
provenance: At the density those researchers measured, a person cannot lift their arms.

text: At the same headcount, a narrow sloping alley is a different kind of place from a wide flat one.
